title: The Efficacy and Safety of Dexibuprofen Syrup
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the safety and efficacy of dexibuprofen syrup and ibuprofen syrup in patients with fever due to common cold.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Common cold with fever
* Age 6 months to 14 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Gastric ulcer
* Bleeding tendency
* Liver disease
* Kidney disease
* Hypertension
* Hypersensitivity to the drug
